entries.title: Introduction
entries.docs: A native Rust workbench for design rules, reusable controls and deterministic composition fixtures. Specimen-only pages are explicitly separated from interactive components.

entries.title: Getting started
entries.docs: Open a page with TEKESUI_GALLERY_PAGE=<route>. Use Tab to move focus, Reset to restore fixtures, and the event log to inspect behavior. No network or user data is used.

entries.title: Component index
entries.docs: Search the navigation by component, story ID or keyword. Planned entries reserve capabilities; they do not claim implementation.

entries.title: Colors & themes
entries.docs: Semantic colors, opacity and compositing rules. Complete token atlas retains the original color, spacing, radius and stroke reference samples; all values follow current JSON tokens.

entries.title: Toolbar
entries.docs: A horizontal group of real actions with shared spacing.
entries.api_notes: Existing action-group model/View and additive original Component ToolbarControl with measured single-row overflow, stable IDs and icons. Module/window process contributions are separate experimental infrastructure; arbitrary caller Content slots and complete remote keyboard/IME/AX remain unaccepted.

entries.title: Rubik's Cube
entries.docs: Independent tekes-ui-scene3d component. glTF 2.0 .glb/.gltf; wgpu animation preview. Default: local indexed Rubik cube GLB. Drag to orbit; right/Shift-drag to rotate; scroll to zoom. Click preview then arrows, +/- or R; Space toggles the layer animation, A auto-rotates. Reduced Motion freezes playback. Optional local asset: TEKESUI_SCENE3D_ASSET. Preview lighting, direct shared GPU texture composition; full PBR remains future work.
